summary: Introducing 3 Brand New Baths to the Studio Bagno Collection - Available in compact 1500mm sizes with overflow, our latest additions are crafted from MarmoTech stone composite, ensuring a luxurious experience and easy maintenance.
title: 3 Stunning New Baths For Bathrooms Big And Small
bodyHtml:
Timeless Design + Versatility in Big & Small Bathrooms

We’re excited to unveil the latest additions to our bath collection — The brand new Vita Bath in 2 versatile sizes and the Lust 1500 Wall-Faced Bath, the latest addition to our best selling Lust Bath series.

Each has been thoughtfully designed to combine style, functionality, and the luxurious experience Studio Bagno is known for.

The New Vita Bath Series

The Vita Bath is an evolution of the timeless pill shape, available in two project friendly sizes: 1500mm and 1700mm.

Designed to suit a wide range of bathroom sizes and project applications, the Vita Bath is equally at home in contemporary or classic interiors. Vita's elegant curves provide a luxurious and comfortable seated experience, combining impeccable usability with timeless beauty.

The New Lust 1500 Wall Faced Bath

The best-selling Lust Bath series just got even better. Now available in a compact 1500mm size with overflow, the Lust 1500 Wall-Faced Bath is perfect for small bathrooms, offering the signature floating aesthetic and subtle curves of its larger counterparts.

Its clever back-to-wall shelf enhances both functionality and design, making it a standout feature in any space.

Crafted with MarmoTech

Marmotech is Studio Bagno’s premium, 100% silica free stone composite material, designed to redefine your bathing experience. Its luxurious texture is gentle to the touch, while its non-porous surface ensures hygiene and easy maintenance.

Quick to warm and exceptional at retaining heat, Marmotech enhances comfort, making every bath a luxurious retreat.
